title: Fix one arrow at a time

text.guided: One of your arrows is already perfect. Do not touch it: place the first arrow, then the second, and read each column on its own.
text.fast: One column right, one wrong: fix them independently.

scene.caption: Start from the identity: î = (1, 0), ĵ = (0, 1)
î stays put, only ĵ moves to (1, 1)
